verses.original: וְיוֹסֵ֖ף הוּרַ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָה מִצְרִ֔י פּוֹטִיפַר֩ סְרִ֨יס פַּרְעֹ֜ה שַׂ֤ר הַטַּבָּחִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ וַיִּקְנֵ֡הוּ מִיַּד֙ הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹרִדֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·sêp̄ hū·raḏ miṣ·rā·yə·māh miṣ·rî pō·w·ṭî·p̄ar sə·rîs par·‘ōh śar haṭ·ṭab·bā·ḥîm ’îš way·yiq·nê·hū mî·yaḏ hay·yiš·mə·‘ê·lîm ’ă·šer hō·w·ri·ḏu·hū šām·māh
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Joseph had been taken down to Egypt where an Egyptian named Potiphar an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard . . . bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיְהִ֤י אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְהִ֖י מַצְלִ֑יחַ אִ֣ישׁ וַיְהִ֕י בְּבֵ֥ית הַמִּצְרִֽי׃ אֲדֹנָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·hî ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·hî maṣ·lî·aḥ ’îš way·hî bə·ḇêṯ ham·miṣ·rî ’ă·ḏō·nāw
verses.literal: And the LORD was with Joseph and he became a successful man serving in the household of his Egyptian master

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֔יו וַיַּ֣רְא כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ יְהוָ֖ה מַצְלִ֥יחַ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃ וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֔ה
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāw way·yar kî Yah·weh ’it·tōw Yah·weh maṣ·lî·aḥ bə·yā·ḏōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- hū ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: When his master saw that the LORD [was] with him [and] made him prosper . . . in all - he did

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֥ף וַיִּמְצָ֨א חֵ֛ן בְּעֵינָ֖יו וַיְשָׁ֣רֶת אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵ֙הוּ֙ עַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ נָתַ֥ן ל֖וֹ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃ וְכָל־ יֶשׁ־
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yim·ṣā ḥên bə·‘ê·nāw way·šā·reṯ ’ō·ṯōw way·yap̄·qi·ḏê·hū ‘al- bê·ṯōw nā·ṯan lōw bə·yā·ḏōw wə·ḵāl yeš-
verses.literal: Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant - Potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted . . . him with everything he owned

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י מֵאָז֩ הִפְקִ֨יד אֹת֜וֹ בְּבֵית֗וֹ וְעַל֙ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ־ ל֔וֹ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ הַמִּצְרִ֖י בֵּ֥ית בִּגְלַ֣ל יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֞י יְהוָה֙ בִּרְכַּ֤ת בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ־ ל֔וֹ בַּבַּ֖יִת וּבַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mê·’āz hip̄·qîḏ ’ō·ṯōw bə·ḇê·ṯōw wə·‘al kāl- ’ă·šer yeš- lōw Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·ḇā·reḵ ham·miṣ·rî bêṯ biḡ·lal yō·w·sêp̄ way·hî Yah·weh bir·kaṯ bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer yeš- lōw bab·ba·yiṯ ū·ḇaś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: From the time that he put [Joseph] in charge - of his household and all - he owned - the LORD - blessed the Egyptian’s household on account of [him] . . . The LORD’s blessing [was] on everything - he owned . . . both in his house and in his field

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֮ יוֹסֵף֒ בְּיַד־ וְלֹא־ יָדַ֤ע אִתּוֹ֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁר־ ה֣וּא אוֹכֵ֑ל יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְהִ֣י יְפֵה־ תֹ֖אַר וִיפֵ֥ה מַרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw yō·w·sêp̄ bə·yaḏ- wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ ’it·tōw mə·’ū·māh kî ’im- hal·le·ḥem ’ă·šer- hū ’ō·w·ḵêl yō·w·sêp̄ way·hî yə·p̄êh- ṯō·’ar wî·p̄êh mar·’eh
verses.literal: So [Potiphar] left all that he owned in Joseph’s care he did not concern himself . . . with anything except . . . the food - he ate Now Joseph was well-built . . . and handsome . . .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲדֹנָ֛יו אֶת־ אֵֽשֶׁת־ וַתִּשָּׂ֧א עֵינֶ֖יהָ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁכְבָ֥ה עִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥar had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ- wat·tiś·śā ‘ê·ne·hā ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ wat·tō·mer šiḵ·ḇāh ‘im·mî
verses.literal: and after some time . . . . . . his master’s - wife cast her eyes upon Joseph and said Sleep with me

verses.original: וַיְמָאֵ֓ן׀ הֵ֣ן וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֔יו אֵ֣שֶׁת אִתִּ֖י אֲדֹנִ֔י לֹא־ יָדַ֥ע מַה־ בַּבָּ֑יִת נָתַ֥ן וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֶשׁ־ ל֖וֹ בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ên hên way·yō·mer ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’ê·šeṯ ’it·tî ’ă·ḏō·nî lō- yā·ḏa‘ mah- bab·bā·yiṯ nā·ṯan wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yeš- lōw bə·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: But he refused Look he said to his master’s wife with me here my master does not concern himself with anything in his house and he has entrusted everything - he owns to my care

verses.original: אֵינֶ֨נּוּ הַזֶּה֮ בַּבַּ֣יִת גָד֜וֹל מִמֶּנִּי֒ חָשַׂ֤ךְ וְלֹֽא־ מְא֔וּמָה מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ כִּ֥י אִם־ אוֹתָ֖ךְ בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתְּ־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨יךְ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֜ה הַזֹּ֔את הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הָרָעָ֤ה וְחָטָ֖אתִי לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·nen·nū haz·zeh bab·ba·yiṯ ḡā·ḏō·wl mim·men·nî ḥā·śaḵ wə·lō- mə·’ū·māh mim·men·nî kî ’im- ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ba·’ă·šer ’at- ’iš·tōw wə·’êḵ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh haz·zōṯ hag·gə·ḏō·lāh hā·rā·‘āh wə·ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: No one in this house is greater than I am He has withheld nothing . . . from me except you - because you are his wife So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כְּדַבְּרָ֥הּ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף י֣וֹם׀ י֑וֹם וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֥ע אֵלֶ֛יהָ לִשְׁכַּ֥ב אֶצְלָ֖הּ לִהְי֥וֹת עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḏab·bə·rāh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ yō·wm yō·wm wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ’ê·le·hā liš·kaḇ ’eṣ·lāh lih·yō·wṯ ‘im·māh
verses.literal: Although [Potiphar’s wife] spoke to Joseph day after day he refused . . . . . . to go to bed with her [or even] be near her

verses.original: כְּהַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְהִי֙ וַיָּבֹ֥א הַבַּ֖יְתָה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת מְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨ין אִ֜ישׁ הַבַּ֛יִת מֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י שָׁ֖ם בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: kə·hay·yō·wm haz·zeh way·hî way·yā·ḇō hab·bay·ṯāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ mə·laḵ·tōw wə·’ên ’îš hab·ba·yiṯ mê·’an·šê šām bab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: One day . . . however [Joseph] went into the house to attend to his work and not a single household servant [was] inside

verses.original: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂ֧הוּ בְּבִגְד֛וֹ לֵאמֹ֖ר שִׁכְבָ֣ה עִמִּ֑י וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ בְּיָדָ֔הּ וַיָּ֖נָס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṯ·pə·śê·hū bə·ḇiḡ·ḏōw lê·mōr šiḵ·ḇāh ‘im·mî way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ biḡ·ḏōw bə·yā·ḏāh way·yā·nās way·yê·ṣê ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: She grabbed [Joseph] by his cloak and said Sleep with me But leaving his cloak in her hand he escaped and ran outside

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּרְאוֹתָ֔הּ כִּֽי־ עָזַ֥ב בִּגְד֖וֹ בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַיָּ֖נָס הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ō·w·ṯāh kî- ‘ā·zaḇ biḡ·ḏōw bə·yā·ḏāh way·yā·nās ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: - When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out [of the house]

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֞א בֵיתָ֗הּ לְאַנְשֵׁ֣י רְא֗וּ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עִבְרִ֖י אִ֥ישׁ הֵ֥בִיא לָ֛נוּ לְצַ֣חֶק בָּ֑נוּ בָּ֤א אֵלַי֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמִּ֔י וָאֶקְרָ֖א בְּק֥וֹל גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā ḇê·ṯāh lə·’an·šê rə·’ū wat·tō·mer lā·hem lê·mōr ‘iḇ·rî ’îš hê·ḇî lā·nū lə·ṣa·ḥeq bā·nū bā ’ê·lay liš·kaḇ ‘im·mî wā·’eq·rā bə·qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: she called her household servants Look she said - this Hebrew . . . has been brought to us to make sport of us He came to me so he could sleep with me but I screamed as loud as I could

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְשָׁמְע֔וֹ כִּֽי־ הֲרִימֹ֥תִי קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ אֶצְלִ֔י וַיָּ֖נָס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵə·šā·mə·‘ōw kî- hă·rî·mō·ṯî qō·w·lî wā·’eq·rā way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ biḡ·ḏōw ’eṣ·lî way·yā·nās way·yê·ṣê ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: - When he heard me . . . scream for help . . . . . . he left his cloak beside me and ran . . . out [of the house]

verses.original: וַתַּנַּ֥ח בִּגְד֖וֹ אֶצְלָ֑הּ עַד־ אֲדֹנָ֖יו אֶל־ בּ֥וֹא בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tan·naḥ biḡ·ḏōw ’eṣ·lāh ‘aḏ- ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’el- bō·w bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: So [Potiphar’s wife] kept Joseph’s cloak beside her until his master . . . came home

verses.original: וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּדְּבָרִ֥ים הָֽעִבְרִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ הָעֶ֧בֶד בָּֽא־ אֵלַ֞י הֵבֵ֥אתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְצַ֥חֶק בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw hā·’êl·leh lê·mōr kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·‘iḇ·rî ’ă·šer- hā·‘e·ḇeḏ bā- ’ê·lay hê·ḇê·ṯā lā·nū lə·ṣa·ḥeq bî
verses.literal: Then she told him . . . the same . . . story The Hebrew - slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּהֲרִימִ֥י קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֥ב בִּגְד֛וֹ אֶצְלִ֖י וַיָּ֥נָס הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·hă·rî·mî qō·w·lî wā·’eq·rā way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ biḡ·ḏōw ’eṣ·lî way·yā·nās ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: - but when I screamed for help . . . . . . he left his cloak beside me and ran out [of the house]

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ אֲדֹנָ֜יו אֶת־ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ דִּבְרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּרָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָאֵ֔לֶּה כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ עָ֥שָׂהּ לִ֖י וַיִּ֖חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’eṯ- ḵiš·mō·a‘ diḇ·rê ’iš·tōw ’ă·šer dib·bə·rāh ’ê·lāw lê·mōr hā·’êl·leh kad·də·ḇā·rîm ‘aḇ·de·ḵā ʿå̄·śå̄h lî way·yi·ḥar ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: When his master - heard the story his wife - told him saying This is what your slave did to me he burned with anger

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֜ף אֲדֹנֵ֨י וַיִּקַּח֩ אֹת֗וֹ וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הַסֹּ֔הַר מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲסוּרִ֑ים אֲסוּרֵי וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית הַסֹּֽהַר׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·ḏō·nê way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·ṯōw way·yit·tə·nê·hū ’el- bêṯ has·sō·har mə·qō·wm ’ă·šer- ham·me·leḵ ’ă·sū·rîm ʾă·sū·rē way·hî- šām bə·ḇêṯ has·sō·har
verses.literal: So Joseph’s master took him and had him thrown into the prison . . . where - the king’s prisoners were confined While [Joseph] was there in the prison . . .

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיְהִ֤י אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיֵּ֥ט חָ֑סֶד אֵלָ֖יו וַיִּתֵּ֣ן חִנּ֔וֹ בְּעֵינֵ֖י בֵּית־ הַסֹּֽהַר׃ שַׂ֥ר
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·hî ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·yêṭ ḥā·seḏ ’ê·lāw way·yit·tên ḥin·nōw bə·‘ê·nê bêṯ- has·sō·har śar
verses.literal: the LORD was with [him] and extended kindness to him granting him favor in the eyes of the prison . . . warden

verses.original: שַׂ֤ר בֵּית־ הַסֹּ֙הַר֙ וַיִּתֵּ֞ן כָּל־ הָ֣אֲסִירִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר וְאֵ֨ת יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת בְּיַד־ ה֖וּא הָיָ֥ה עֹשִׂים֙ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשֶֽׂה׃ שָׁ֔ם בְּבֵ֣ית הַסֹּ֑הַר
verses.transliteration: śar bêṯ- has·sō·har way·yit·tên kāl- hā·’ă·sî·rim ’ă·šer wə·’êṯ yō·w·sêp̄ ’êṯ bə·yaḏ- hū hā·yāh ‘ō·śîm kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ō·śeh šām bə·ḇêṯ has·sō·har
verses.literal: And the warden . . . . . . put all the prisoners . . . - under Joseph’s - care so that he was responsible for all that was done - in the prison

verses.original: שַׂ֣ר בֵּית־ הַסֹּ֗הַר אֶֽת־ אֵ֣ין׀ רֹאֶ֤ה כָּל־ מְא֙וּמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה מַצְלִֽיחַ׃ס וַֽאֲשֶׁר־ ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: śar bêṯ- has·sō·har ’eṯ- ’ên rō·’eh kāl- mə·’ū·māh bə·yā·ḏōw ba·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’it·tōw Yah·weh maṣ·lî·aḥ wa·’ă·šer- hū ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: The warden . . . . . . - did not concern himself with anything . . . under Joseph’s care because the LORD was with [Joseph] - and gave him success in whatever he did
